segment.source: Renders a titled rule that closes one part of a long page and opens the next: an eyebrow, a heading, an optional line under it and a separator. Use it for: chapter breaks in a handbook, the start of a new topic in a report, splitting a one-page guide into named parts. Prefer 'Statement Band' when the words are a claim rather than a label, and 'Rich Text' when the heading really belongs to the prose beneath it.
